pending.caption:
FIKS 63rd Junior, December 2025. Two trophies. Both first place.

One for doubles, one for singles — same week, same podium. Hard to describe what that felt like.

Chasing every ball, earning every dream.

last_published.content_type: Arc 2 Thailand ITF forehand action — red jersey, scoreboard, Nonthaburi venue
last_published.caption:
Nonthaburi, Thailand. Had to stay low and drive through this one.

Courts at the ITF Asia 12&U Team Competition were fast — you had to rotate fully or the ball went straight past you.

Scoreboard behind me. Red jersey on. I knew exactly what I had to do.

Chasing every ball, earning every dream.

#marshatennisjourney #teamindonesia #indonesiatennis #itfjunior #juniortennis #atfjunior
